## Design Taste
*Source: https://www.glideapps.com/ — generated by /taste (pages analyzed: `/`, `/pricing`, `/product`)*

### Tokens

**Color** — no chromatic accent. One warm-tinted neutral ramp, every value carrying a 2–3 point blue deficit.
- `#FFFFFF` background · `#F5F5F2` section fill · `#EDEDE8` alt fill
- `#171715` inverse surface · `#0E0E0D` deep inverse
- `#2E2E2B` primary text · `#000000` strong text · `#5E5E5C` secondary text
- `#242421` CTA fill · `rgba(0,0,0,0.06)` hairline border
- Accent: none. Reserve saturation for product screenshots and imagery.

**Typography** — one family, all roles. Weights 450 / 500 / 575 / 600 only — never 400, never 700.
- `85px/93.5px/575` hero-xl · `60px/60px/575` hero · `48px/48px/575` h2 · `32px/38.4px/575` h2-compact
- `22px/28.6px/600` h3 · `20px/26px/450` body-lead · `16px/24px/450` body · `14px/450` UI · `12px/450` caption
- **Tracking rule: `letter-spacing = -0.02em` at every size.**
- Display type (≥48px) gets `line-height: 1`. Body relaxes to 1.5.
- Cap body measure at 620–690px regardless of container width.

**Spacing** — 4px base. Scale: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 52, 64, 96, 120, 192.
- Section gap `192px`. Section horizontal inset `52px`. Grid gutter `16px`.
- `gap` for inner rhythm, `padding` for outer rhythm, `margin: 0` everywhere else.

**Radius** — `6px` button · `8px` inner block · `12px` card · `14px` chip · `24px` composer shell · `9999px` pill.
Nested radii always step down, or jump to a full pill.

**Depth** — `0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)` is the default separator: a ring, zero blur.
One real drop shadow per page maximum, on the single element meant to win.

**Motion** — `transition: color, background-color, border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)` as the default.
`opacity` 300ms for reveals, `transform` 167ms `cubic-bezier(0.33,0,0,1)`. Never animate `height`, `top`, or `left`.

**Layout** — full-bleed container, narrow measure. Centered spine for persuasive copy; left-aligned columns for comparable data.
Separate sections with whitespace and background-fill changes. No horizontal rules.

### Directives

- Do not introduce a brand accent color. Hierarchy comes from weight, size, and value — not hue.
- Warm every neutral by 2–3 points in the blue channel. Pure `#888` / `#CCC` / `#F5F5F5` are off-system.
- Use one font family across display, body, and UI. Do not pair a display face with a body face.
- Apply the −2% tracking rule to every text size, including 14px UI text (`-0.14px`).
- Set `line-height: 1` on any headline 48px or larger so a two-line headline reads as one block.
- Default to a hairline ring for separation. Spend a visible drop shadow only where one element must beat its siblings.
- Give the primary interaction its real input inline (the actual field, prefilled with a prompt), repeated at multiple scroll depths — rather than a CTA button that routes elsewhere.
- Reset margins to zero and carry all rhythm on `gap` and `padding`.
- Ship `:focus-visible` styles and honor `prefers-reduced-motion` — both are present site-wide on the source.

### Never

- Never add a colored accent for "visual interest" — the accent slot is deliberately empty.
- Never use font-weight 400 or 700; the system runs on 450 and 575.
- Never put a drop shadow on every card. Flat siblings are what make the one elevated card readable.
- Never separate sections with `<hr>` or a border — use 192px of whitespace or a background change.
- Never let body copy run the full container width.
- Never animate `height`, `top`, or `left`.
